snippet.title: HITMAN World of Assassination – Eminem vs. Slim Shady Elusive Target | Xbox Partner Preview 2025
snippet.description:
Are you ready to dance with the devil 😈 or are you too deaf to hear the beat 🎵?

The ultimate face-off is coming to HITMAN World of Assassination - Eminem vs. Slim Shady. 🎯

Infiltrate a surreal environment where doctors, patients, and performers blur into one and take down the crazy part of Eminem.

Play for FREE this December with Xbox Series X|S and Xbox on PC. Also on Xbox ROG Ally.
https://www.xbox.com/games/store/hitman-world-of-assassination/9NN82NH949D5/0010

Hitman is coming to Xbox Series X|S and Xbox on PC as an Xbox Play Anywhere title.
